description: This file is an HTML page serving as a frontend UI for visualizing and browsing database contents. It contains embedded CSS styles and JavaScript code that manages fetching database, table, and data info via API calls, rendering tables, handling user interactions like refreshing data, expanding cell content, and navigating the database schema.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the API and updates the sidebar UI.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables and loads table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches the data for a selected table and renders it as an interactive table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for displaying fetched table data with scroll hints and interaction.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell with special handling for nulls, objects, or long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full text or object details.
